lyrics.original: 한 번 싸우면, 이틀은 가니까
lyrics.romanization: han beon ssaumyeon, iteureun ganikka
lyrics.english: If we fight once, it lasts for two days

lyrics.original: 딱 세 번만 참으려 했는데
lyrics.romanization: ttak se beonman chameuryeo haenneunde
lyrics.english: I tried to hold back just three times

lyrics.original: 이깟 사랑이 뭔지, 다섯 번은 더 참고 있는
lyrics.romanization: ikkat sarangi mwonji daseot beoneun, deo chamgo inneun
lyrics.english: What even is this love, I keep enduring it five more times

lyrics.original: 내가 진짜 호구인가 싶다
lyrics.romanization: naega jinjja hoguinga sipda
lyrics.english: I wonder if I’m really a fool

lyrics.original: 또 뭐가 왜?, 네 눈칫밥에
lyrics.romanization: tto mwoga wae?, ne nunchitbabe
lyrics.english: What’s wrong again?, Because of your mood

lyrics.original: 끼니를 걸렀어도 배가 불러
lyrics.romanization: kkinireul geolleosseodo baega bulleo
lyrics.english: Even if I skip a meal I’m still full

lyrics.original: 한 시간째 입도 못 댄 커피는, 우리 사이처럼 밍밍해졌어
lyrics.romanization: han siganjjae ipdo mot daen keopineun, uri saicheoreom mingminghaejyeosseo
lyrics.english: The coffee I haven’t touched for an hour, Has gone bland just like us

lyrics.original: 한바탕 또 타오르다 말 작은 불씨인데
lyrics.romanization: hanbatang tto taoreuda mal jageun bulssiinde
lyrics.english: It’s just a small spark after flaring up again

lyrics.original: 한숨 한 번 잘못 쉬었다가, 넌 다시 불이 붙었고, 내 속은 까매지는 걸
lyrics.romanization: hansum han beon jalmot swieotdaga, neon dasi buri buteotgo, nae sogeun kkamaejineun geol
lyrics.english: But I let out a sigh the wrong way, And you caught fire again, While my insides turn black

lyrics.original: 사람들의 좋은 구경거리가 되긴 싫은 걸
lyrics.romanization: saramdeurui joeun gugyeonggeoriga doegin sileun geol
lyrics.english: I don’t want to become something good for other people to watch

lyrics.original: 그래서 참고 참는데
lyrics.romanization: geuraeseo chamgo chamneunde
lyrics.english: So I keep holding it in

lyrics.original: 왜 맘 더 긁어 자꾸, 나도 화낼 줄 아는데
lyrics.romanization: wae mam deo geulgeo jakku, nado hwanael jul aneunde
lyrics.english: Why do you keep hurting my heart?, I know how to get angry too

lyrics.original: 우리 한 번 싸우면, 이틀은 가니까
lyrics.romanization: uri han beon ssaumyeon, iteureun ganikka
lyrics.english: If we fight once, it lasts for two days

lyrics.original: 딱 세 번만 참으려 했는데
lyrics.romanization: ttak se beonman chameuryeo haenneunde
lyrics.english: I tried to hold back just three times

lyrics.romanization: ikkat sarangi mwonji, daseot beoneun deo chamgo inneun

lyrics.original: 내가 진짜 호구인가 싶다
lyrics.romanization: naega jinjja hoguinga sipda
lyrics.english: I wonder if I’m really a fool

lyrics.original: 넌 한숨 쉬는 날, 이해 못 하니까
lyrics.romanization: neon hansum swineun nal, ihae mot hanikka
lyrics.english: You don’t understand when I sigh, So I’ll try holding my breath

lyrics.original: 딱 3초만 숨 참아보려 해
lyrics.romanization: ttak samchoman sum chamaboryeo hae
lyrics.english: For just three seconds

lyrics.original: 이깟 사랑이 뭔지, 다섯 살짜리 애처럼
lyrics.romanization: ikkat sarangi mwonji, daseot saljjari aecheoreom
lyrics.english: What even is this love, Like a five year old child

lyrics.original: 숫자나 세는 내가 참 싫다
lyrics.romanization: sutjana seneun naega cham silta
lyrics.english: I hate myself for just counting numbers

lyrics.romanization: one two three four five sumneomeogagi jikjeon ninety nine point nine
lyrics.english: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5  just before I run out of breath 99.9%

lyrics.original: 몇 초 남았어?
lyrics.romanization: myeot cho namasseo?
lyrics.english: How many seconds are left?

lyrics.original: 한숨만 나와 countdown 매일 헷갈려
lyrics.romanization: hansumman nawa countdown maeil hetgallyeo
lyrics.english: All that comes out is a sigh countdown I get confused every day

lyrics.original: 갈 곳 잃은 손 24/7 yeah yeah
lyrics.romanization: gal got ileun son twenty four seven yeah yeah
lyrics.english: Hands that have lost where to go twenty four seven yeah yeah
